metadata.network: No network or installation. Playwright fulfills http://spike.invalid/* directly from local production build files; all other HTTP(S) requests are aborted. No listening server or HTTP connection.
limitations: CDP preedit simulates Chromium composition plumbing, not the real Windows Korean IME/TSF, 2-beolsik key-to-jamo conversion, candidate window, reconversion, OS/browser keyboard event ordering, or hardware/layout behavior.
Enter/Backspace are injected DOM key paths; IME consumption and keyCode 229 can differ on Windows. Backspace uses an explicit modeled preedit update. Success is not proof of Windows IME reliability.
The slash/submit check covers the common guarded app handler only. A future menu/plugin or app key handler requires separate checks.
Tiptap uses local minimal table/image adapters because official packages are not installed; their serializer results and bundle bytes must not be attributed solely to upstream Tiptap.
Headless Chromium/Linux only; real Windows Chrome/Edge Korean Microsoft IME manual checks remain mandatory before choosing on IME grounds.
manualCheck: Windows 11 Microsoft Korean IME (2-beolsik), Chrome and Edge: repeat every case using physical keys; observe final text and caret.
Specifically check Enter commits without slash/submit, Ctrl+Enter while preediting, jamo Backspace, undo after commit, and rapid Enter/Arrow navigation across blocks.
Test candidate selection/reconversion, focus loss/regain and paste with actual IME; record OS/browser/IME versions and screen capture.

browserExecution.reason: --model-only: retained existing IME data; no browser launch attempted

bundle.mode: Vite production, separate entry per candidate; same React UI, measurement API and features included
bundle.compression: Node zlib.gzipSync, level 9, each emitted file separately; sourcemaps disabled
bundle.caveat: Individual core, commonmark, gfm, history and clipboard packages; own React UI; no Crepe or kit. No optional block/drag/slash package UI.

ime.protocol: Real trusted browser composition events via CDP Input.imeSetComposition (intermediate jamo) and Input.insertText (commit). CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent for special keys. No JS-dispatched CompositionEvent.
ime.backspaceSemantics: Send Backspace during active 한 preedit, then explicitly model IME update to 하 and commit 하. CDP does not implement Windows jamo deletion logic; the after-key checkpoint captures browser default effects separately.
ime.fastSemantics: No per-stroke delays: commit 한, real ArrowDown/End, commit 글, real ArrowDown/End, commit 입 across three existing paragraphs.
ime.cdpSimulatedMeaning: Trusted compositionstart+compositionupdate, compositionend observed with any isTrusted, and text/caret/structure/console/Enter-guard checks pass. Not proof of real Windows Korean IME behaviour.

roundtrip.execution: Node: actual editor parser -> ProseMirror document (doc.check) -> actual serializer. No browser EditorView. Tiptap HTML tokens use inert literal nodes in both runtimes; DOM behavior is unmeasured.

bundle.mode: Vite production, separate entry per candidate; same React UI, measurement API and features included
bundle.compression: Node zlib.gzipSync, level 9, each emitted file separately; sourcemaps disabled
bundle.caveat: Installed official table/image extensions are absent. Includes local minimal Node adapters using installed prosemirror-tables plus built-in TaskList/TaskItem. Not a measurement of the official Tiptap table extension or full table UI.

ime.protocol: Real trusted browser composition events via CDP Input.imeSetComposition (intermediate jamo) and Input.insertText (commit). CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent for special keys. No JS-dispatched CompositionEvent.
ime.backspaceSemantics: Send Backspace during active 한 preedit, then explicitly model IME update to 하 and commit 하. CDP does not implement Windows jamo deletion logic; the after-key checkpoint captures browser default effects separately.
ime.fastSemantics: No per-stroke delays: commit 한, real ArrowDown/End, commit 글, real ArrowDown/End, commit 입 across three existing paragraphs.
ime.cdpSimulatedMeaning: Trusted compositionstart+compositionupdate, compositionend observed with any isTrusted, and text/caret/structure/console/Enter-guard checks pass. Not proof of real Windows Korean IME behaviour.
